responsibility: Defines the full-width x86 AVX-512 IFMA intrinsic API for 52-bit integer fused multiply-add operations on packed 64-bit lanes. It enables avx512ifma and exposes masked and unmasked wrappers for _mm512_madd52lo_epu64 and _mm512_madd52hi_epu64, giving GCC users the baseline 512-bit IFMA interface distinct from the VL-sized companion header.
